analysis: Report all four planned entries, including unexecuted slots, and every reservation/start/terminal receipt. Pair profiles within each request; no population significance from two requests. Closure acceptance is distinct from exit/usage/cleanup. Unsupported implementation shapes, service failures and missing usage are unknown and do not create ability/training labels. Classifier scores are uncalibrated hypotheses. Original modules/Go language, source shapes, full prompts and finite acceptance contracts are part of the measured development task; they do not establish full upstream correctness or license compliance.
authorization: The user authorized self-use on public coding tasks, ongoing evidence-backed experiments, and public GitHub/Hugging Face records. This pilot uses existing local ChatGPT Codex login only; no API-key billing, cloud training jobs, new endpoint, or purchased credits.

cli.auth: ChatGPT login locally observed. Copy only required auth.json to a fresh private controlled home outside the model workspace; do not publish or hash credentials. API-key auth and unrelated inherited tokens are refused.
cli.inference_network: Parent CLI may contact its configured official service; model-generated commands have no network permission.
cli.model_identity: Requested model/reasoning and exact applied child invocation are recorded separately from provider-observed identity. Current exec JSONL gives no provider-attested model identity; observed_model remains unknown. Model availability cache is not proof of a successful invocation.

evidence: Immutable licensed public source manifest, independent contracts, exact original module recipe and Go executable. Candidate tests are excluded; only declared mutable source is assessed. Original license staging and source copyright checks are separate from candidate attribution. Publish sanitized records and hashes only; raw traces/auth/cache/local paths/model assets remain private.

execution.limits: All started CLI attempts count, including provider/auth failures, timeout, capture/parse failure and verifier unknown. One Codex CLI invocation may contain multiple internal model requests and provider retries; those counts are unknown. No executor-level silent repeat to improve a result. Parent-process time is measured separately from verifier time; child CPU/RSS if captured is local CLI, never remote model GPU or backend memory. Fixed CLI invocation count and wall limits bound this pilot; monetary/subscription usage is unknown rather than guessed from tokens.
execution.parent_budget: Both child plans share exactly one preselected durable private ledger. The parent manifest fixes H/Sol,U/Luna,H/Luna,U/Sol; four no-refund reservations, one concurrent owner. The cap applies to owned main starts in that one ledger, not host/account-wide or unknown backend requests. Never reset/recreate the ledger or retry a reserved slot.

go_toolchain.evidence: Explicit resolved trusted local installation, version checked offline and executable bytes pinned before inference; no local absolute path published and no hostile-host attestation.

isolation: macOS only until other enforcement is proven. Use current Codex named permissions profile with root deny, platform minimal read, fresh workspace write, temporary and slash-tmp deny, explicit trusted Go toolchain read, generated-command network disabled, never-approval and no user config/rules/skills/MCP/history inheritance. A real offline probe must demonstrate workspace write, sibling read denial and network denial to a live host-control endpoint before inference. No main checkout edits. Kill/wait child process group before candidate snapshot; retain private traces and numeric record, remove copied authentication after terminal cleanup.

model_discovery.limit: Metadata observation only. Actual per-request inference access remains unverified; bundled/fallback behavior is not independently ruled out.
model_discovery.method: codex --no-daemon debug models; one fresh isolated authenticated HOME and no prior settings/cache

publication: Branch/PR and exact-head CI quality merge gate; race/vet/format/redacted secrets before push. GitHub records code/plans/numeric results and KO/EN guidance. Model binaries, raw traces, authentication and caches stay local; this cycle creates no new model release or production activation. HF may reference the public research record without claiming new weights or validated routing.
purpose: Two distinct external Go requests form a paired development pilot: one Sol low and one Luna low per request. Full clarified v2 prompts and unchanged original module language are pinned. This is two new actually attempted logical requests only if started, not four requests, not protected-final or training eligibility and not evidence of savings. Grow verified development requests toward120 and240 before collecting a separate final set of at least2400 distinct requests per claimed domain.

routing_hypothesis.method: One unchanged native Laya CPU prediction for this exact full Spec.Prompt before actual coding outcomes. No shortening/routing view or threshold change. Token budget512; disclose truncation and resulting abstention. Prediction input SHA equals full coding prompt SHA even when tokenization truncates. Explicit paired profile order is independent of the proposal; no live routing activation.
routing_hypothesis.resource_limit: Only one local CPU encoder process; private whole-process OS RSS observation, not Go heap, GPU memory or remote coding-model resource use.
routing_hypothesis.router_build: trimpath buildvcs=false from immutable public Git source archive; this artifact has no VCS metadata, unlike the separately cleanVCS executor

stop: Refuse before inference on changed CLI/toolchain/base/spec/recipe/auth or failed isolation probe. Stop remaining scheduled entries on executor/record/ledger integrity failure, auth cleanup failure, persistent resource failure, confirmed requested-profile unavailability or unresolved reservation launch state. A recorded behavioral rejection or bounded-shape unknown alone does not imply a model capability failure or warrant a retry; continue only if durable terminal proof and cleanup remain valid. Preserve all started and unexecuted entries, no fallback/resume/refund, no threshold relaxation and no protected-final scoring.

supersedes.reason: A separately precommitted paired two-source study after pilot54; no external source requests were previously model-attempted. v2 clarifies the same prepared logical requests and evaluation language, not new semantic tasks or rewritten historical results.
